one_liner: Cardiology data integration centre with 14 years of linked ECG, echo and structured EHR.
summary: The DIC at UKN provides FHIR-conformant routine care data under the nationwide MII Broad Consent. Our cardiology holdings combine structured EHR, full-disclosure 12-lead ECG waveforms and echocardiography loops, with in-house linkage to readmission and mortality outcomes. We have never released data outside our own processing environment and do not intend to. We are looking for a modelling partner who can work inside it.
_test_case: Strong domain/modality match for several teams, but data cannot leave. Must HARD BLOCK any team whose privacy_capability is requires_data_export with no TRE or federated capability.

one_liner: Fifteen years of digitised colorectal histopathology, linked to national survival outcomes.
summary: A regional pathology archive covering four hospitals, fully digitised from 2009 onward and linked at patient level to national cancer registry staging, treatment and survival data. Slides are de-identified at source. We have an existing data use agreement template and have released data to three prior research consortia.
_test_case: The star listing. Exportable, AI-ready, outcome-linked. Will attract the most intro requests — use this to test the 5-per-24h rate limit and the inbox UI under load.

org_name: Centre Hospitalier Régional de la Garonne — Département d'Imagerie
one_liner: Cohorte IRM cérébrale longitudinale en sclérose en plaques, annotée par des neuroradiologues.
summary: Suivi IRM sur douze ans d'une cohorte de patients atteints de sclérose en plaques, avec segmentation lésionnelle validée par deux neuroradiologues. Les données ne quittent pas l'établissement ; nous disposons d'un nœud d'apprentissage fédéré opérationnel. Nous cherchons une équipe capable de travailler en fédéré.

datasets.name: Cohorte IRM cérébrale — sclérose en plaques

_test_case: French-only listing. Tests the i18n path end to end — this profile must be discoverable and comprehensible to a German-speaking user. Also tests that federated_no_movement scores FULL marks against a federated_capable team rather than being penalised.

one_liner: Twenty-seven years of national prescription, diagnosis and mortality linkage at population scale.
summary: A national-scale linked registry covering prescriptions, hospital contacts, diagnoses and mortality from 1998 to present. Access is exclusively via our audited secure processing environment; no microdata is ever released. Analysts apply for a project account and work remotely inside the environment. Approval typically takes eight to twelve weeks.
_test_case: parallel_public_funding is 'unsure', not 'no'. Must surface as a SOFT blocker with a clear prompt to resolve it — not a silent rank drop, and not a hard block. Also: available_from is AFTER the challenge Stage 1 start. The UI should flag date incompatibility; the scorer currently does not. Decide whether that becomes a factor.

one_liner: Deeply phenotyped undiagnosed rare disease cohort with trio whole-genome sequencing.
summary: A small but exceptionally deep cohort of undiagnosed paediatric patients with trio whole-genome sequencing, longitudinal clinical notes and MRI. Detailed dataset characteristics are shared with matched partners after mutual introduction, not publicly.

datasets.name: Undiagnosed rare disease multi-omics cohort
datasets.governance_notes: PRIVATE — 430 trios. Cantonal ethics amendment pending for secondary AI use; expected decision October 2026.

_test_case: Three things at once. (1) Switzerland is EFTA and therefore ELIGIBLE — the country list must get this right. (2) publicly_describable is false: assert via test that n_subjects, volume and governance_notes appear in NO public API response or rendered HTML. (3) n_subjects is lt_1k, so any team needing 10k+ must take the graded scale penalty even on a perfect domain match.
